svg.title: My work: how the pieces fit — SoftTrack web design mockup (#236)
svg.desc: SoftTrack opens on a team’s board, which answers what the team is doing and leaves what I am doing to be worked out. The epic adds a page of one’s own, filters that take several values and more fields, notifications chosen kind by kind with due-date reminders and a chat channel, and tickets that recur.
svg.text: My work: how the pieces fit
· a home across teams, sharper filters and reminders

g.text: Where signing in lands, whether or not you are on a team.
Assigned to me, due soon, watching, created by me,
The teams there are, and a way to ask.
The board, the list, saved views, the CSV export and search.
Mei or Daniel, and bugs. Any or all labels. Not Done.
Created by, watching, updated, has no. And “me”.
In the app, by email, and where the team already talks.
A switch for each kind on each channel.
The day before, and when late.
Every Monday, every quarter, or once the last one is done.

svg.text: A comment on what you watch
A status change on what you watch
The defaults are what happens today, so nobody’s notifications change when this ships. Two kinds stay on in the app:
they are the tracker reaching you.
Principles: nothing here widens what anybody can see, since every list is tickets on teams the viewer belongs to; links keep working, so a filter saved last year opens the same list;
and no query language. Each piece has its own mockup on its issue, #258 to #265.
